scope: Official documentation for the local proof only; no provider compatibility test

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 advisory lock functions
sources.supports: Try transaction-level advisory lock acquisition is nonblocking; transaction completion releases the lock.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 advisory locking semantics
sources.supports: Advisory locking coordinates cooperating applications and does not enforce locking on unrelated SQL changes.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 transaction isolation and read-only access
sources.supports: Repeatable-read/read-only properties apply within a transaction and do not create an atomic pair across databases or a general SQL sandbox.
